summary_1line: A Brahmana family laments their turn to be sacrificed to the man-eating Rakshasa Vaka until Kunti offers one of her sons instead.

image_candidates.scene_text: A small child smilingly lifts a blade of grass and declares he will slay the man-eating Rakshasa while his grieving family weeps around him.
The Brahmana family sits together in despair, parents and daughter weeping while Kunti approaches them quietly to speak.
Kunti calmly tells the distressed Brahmana that one of her five sons will carry the tribute to the Rakshasa instead of his family.
